name: Set Abilities
description: The Set Ability key and HUD meters

pages.title: Set Abilities
pages.text:
A few full sets also have an **ability**, used with the **Set Ability key**: **R** by default. Change it under Controls, in the Gear Expansion category.

The key uses the ability of the full set you're wearing:

- **Spring Release** (Brass)
- **Ground Slam** (Tungsten)
- **Transform** (Magical Girl)
- **Eruption** (Infernium)

pages.title: HUD Meters
pages.text:
Meters appear above the hotbar only when they matter:

- Brass's spring
- Infernium's heat gauge
- Amethyst's crystal shell
- the ability cooldown
